2026_03_KC_MIA.headline: Kansas City’s protection faces Miami’s speed in a matchup that can turn on explosive plays
2026_03_KC_MIA.paragraph1: Kansas City’s offense is still built around Patrick Mahomes creating answers before and after the snap, but protection remains central as he works behind a line that drew scrutiny entering the season. Miami can stress that structure with speed and simulated pressure, then try to create space for its own playmakers against Kansas City’s defense. The Chiefs need to prevent negative plays from disrupting drives; the Dolphins need explosives without exposing their quarterback to obvious passing-down pressure.
2026_03_KC_MIA.model_rationale: Kansas City’s ability to protect and stay efficient gives Mahomes more answers, while Miami needs speed and explosive plays to prevent the Chiefs from controlling possession and situation.
